Since j is odd, x_{j-1} is at position j-1 (even), so it enters with sign -; x_{j+1} is at position j (odd now since one element removed), so enters with sign +.

D(X) - (x_j - D(X\{x_j})) = D(X) + D(X\{x_j}) - x_j.

D(X) = Σ_{i<j} (-1)^{i+1} x_i + x_j + Σ_{i>j} (-1)^{i+1} x_i, with j even so (-1)^{j+1} = -1; wait for j even, sign of x_j in D(X) is (-1)^{j+1} = (-1)^{odd} = -1. So D(X) = Σ_{i<j}(-1)^{i+1}x_i - x_j + Σ_{i>j}(-1)^{i+1}x_i.

Sum = 2Σ_{i<j}(-1)^{i+1}x_i + x_j. So D(X) + D(X\{x_j}) - x_j = 2Σ_{i<j}(-1)^{i+1}x_i = 2[(x_1-x_2)+...+(x_{j-2}-x_{j-1})]. Matches. Good.
